# Country scope (active Phoenix Empire or variable-marked Western Rome).
# Synchronizes var:oe_roman_gov_stage (1..5) and idempotently applies the matching stage modifier.
oe_v61_roman_sync_stage_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            current_year >= 361
            is_rebel_country = no
            oe_v61_is_active_phoenix_governance = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    oe_v61_roman_stage_5 = yes
                    var:oe_v61_stage_override ?= 5
                }
            }
            set_variable = { name = oe_roman_gov_stage value = 5 }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_1_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_1_mod }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_2_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_2_mod }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_3_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_3_mod }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_4_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_4_mod }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_5_mod } }
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_5_mod years = -1 mode = replace }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    oe_v61_roman_stage_4 = yes
                    var:oe_v61_stage_override ?= 4
                }
            }
            set_variable = { name = oe_roman_gov_stage value = 4 }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_1_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_1_mod }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_2_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_2_mod }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_3_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_3_mod }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_5_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_5_mod }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_4_mod } }
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_4_mod years = -1 mode = replace }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    oe_v61_roman_stage_3 = yes
                    var:oe_v61_stage_override ?= 3
                }
            }
            set_variable = { name = oe_roman_gov_stage value = 3 }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_1_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_1_mod }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_2_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_2_mod }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_4_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_4_mod }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_5_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_5_mod }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_3_mod } }
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_3_mod years = -1 mode = replace }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    oe_v61_roman_stage_2 = yes
                    var:oe_v61_stage_override ?= 2
                }
            }
            set_variable = { name = oe_roman_gov_stage value = 2 }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_1_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_1_mod }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_3_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_3_mod }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_4_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_4_mod }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_5_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_5_mod }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_2_mod } }
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_2_mod years = -1 mode = replace }
            }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_roman_gov_stage value = 1 }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_2_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_2_mod }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_3_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_3_mod }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_4_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_4_mod }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_5_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_5_mod }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_1_mod } }
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v61_roman_stage_1_mod years = -1 mode = replace }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. Idempotent Day-1 pre-1337 (361-1260) bootstrap of oe_byz_empire_pillars for BYZ/ROM.
# Reuses exact proven EU5 1.4.9 syntax from oe_byz_1453_bootstrap_core_ios while keeping all
# 1337 Palaiologan Civil War lines permanently locked (oe_start_1337 = 0).
oe_v61_roman_bootstrap_pillars_pre1337 = {
    oe_ml_mark_start = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            current_year >= 361
            current_year < 1337
            NOT = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes }
            NOT = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v61_pre1337_pillars_bootstrapped }
            OR = {
                AND = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_rebel_country = no NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes } } }
                AND = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { is_rebel_country = no } }
            }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_v61_pre1337_pillars_bootstrapped value = 1 }
        oe_phoenix_empire_sync = yes
        oe_theme_regions_assign = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                country_exists = c:BYZ
                c:BYZ = { is_rebel_country = no NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes } }
            }
            c:BYZ = { save_scope_as = oe_v61_founder }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                country_exists = c:ROM
                c:ROM = { is_rebel_country = no }
            }
            c:ROM = { save_scope_as = oe_v61_founder }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_v61_founder }
            scope:oe_v61_founder = {
                create_international_organization = {
                    type = international_organization_type:oe_byz_empire_pillars
                    add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_v61_founder
                    set_leader_country = scope:oe_v61_founder
                    international_organization_add_special_status = {
                        type = special_status:oe_pillars_empire
                        country = scope:oe_v61_founder
                    }
                    add_policy_to_international_organization = policy:oe_byz_theme_governor_administration
                    add_policy_to_international_organization = policy:oe_pillars_justinian_code
                    add_policy_to_international_organization = policy:oe_pillars_roman_citizenship
                    add_policy_to_international_organization = policy:oe_pillars_land_preemption
                }
                international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= {
                    set_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority value = 25 }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_pillars_public_opinion value = 50 }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_pillars_opening_resources_initialized value = yes }
                    oe_pillars_sync_effect = yes
                }
                oe_court_initialize = yes
                oe_theme_empire_sync_caps = yes
                oe_v61_roman_sync_stage_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
}
